oeis_name: Catalan numbers: C(n) = binomial(2n,n)/(n+1) = (2n)!/(n!(n+1)!).
Prime gaps: differences between consecutive primes.

description: Smaller prime in each twin-prime pair
oeis_name: Lesser of twin primes.
a(n) = binomial(2n,n)^3.

description: Numerator of the second-order harmonic number $\sum_{k=1}^n k^{-2}$
oeis_name: Wolstenholme numbers: numerator of Sum_{k=1..n} 1/k^2.
Smallest prime > n^2.

description: Number of \(k\le n\) whose prime factors all divide \(n\)
oeis_name: Number of numbers <= n whose set of prime factors is a subset of the set of prime factors of n.

description: Denominator of the sum of reciprocals of divisors of \(n\)
oeis_name: Denominator of sum of reciprocals of divisors of n.

description: Alternating extremal-integer ratio recurrence, starting with 4, 16
oeis_name: For even n, a(n+2) is the greatest integer such that a(n+2)/a(n+1) < a(n+1)/a(n); for odd n, the least integer such that a(n+2)/a(n+1) > a(n+1)/a(n); a(0) = 4, a(1) = 16.

description: Number of ternary words of length \(n\) avoiding 00

oeis_name: Denominators of coefficients in Stirling's expansion for log(Gamma(z)).
Nearest integer to n/sqrt(2).

description: Nonempty subsets of \(\{1,\ldots,n\}\) with integer average
oeis_name: Number of nonempty subsets of {1,2,3,...,n} whose elements have an integer average.
Expansion of g.f. (1-sqrt(1-4*x-4*x^2))/(2*(1+x)).
Smallest number whose Euler totient is divisible by 2^n.
Numerator of 1/det(M) where M is the n X n matrix with M[i,j] = 1/lcm(i,j).

description: Least n-multiple whose digit reversal is also an n-multiple
oeis_name: First multiple of n whose reverse is also divisible by n, or 0 if no such multiple exists.

description: Numerator minus denominator of the n-th harmonic number
oeis_name: Numerator - denominator in n-th harmonic number, 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + ... + 1/n.

description: Factorial-scaled Möbius transform of the harmonic numbers
oeis_name: Sum_{k|n} a(k)/k! = Sum_{j=1 to n} 1/j, sum on left is over positive divisors k of n.

description: Value of the \(n\)th cyclotomic polynomial at \(n\)
oeis_name: Value of n-th cyclotomic polynomial at n.

description: Absolute differences of opposite concatenations of consecutive terms
oeis_name: a(1)=0, a(1)=1, a(n+2)=abs(concatenate(a(n+1)a(n))-concatenate(a(n)a(n+1))).
a(n) = sigma_2(n) + phi(n) * sigma(n) - 2*n^2, which is A072779(n) - 2*n^2.

description: Least prime of form \(k^n-n\), or 0 if none
oeis_name: Smallest prime p such that p + n is an n-th power, or 0 if no such number exists; i.e., smallest prime of the form k^n - n.
Expansion of (1 - x)/(1 - 2*x + 3*x^2) in powers of x.

description: Number of twin-prime pairs between \(n^2\) and \((n+1)^2\)
oeis_name: Number of pairs of twin primes between n^2 and (n+1)^2.

description: Products of composites in successive triangular-number blocks
oeis_name: Product of composite numbers among next n numbers.

description: Prime-counted Pentanacci sequence initialized with five 1’s
oeis_name: Pentanacci pi function: a(1)=a(2)=a(3)=a(4)=a(5)=1; for n>5, a(n) = pi(Sum_{j=1..5} a(n-j)) where pi = A000720.

description: Chebyshev–binomial transform of the negated Fibonacci numbers
oeis_name: A transform of the Fibonacci numbers.

Corresponds to m = 8 in a family of 4th-order linear recurrence sequences given by a(m,n) = m^4*a(n-4) + (2*m)^2*a(n-3) - 4*a(m-1), a(m,0) = -1, a(m,1) = 4, a(m,2) = -13 + 6*(m-1) + 3*(m-1)^2, a(m,3) = (-8+m^2)^2.
Numerator of zeta(4n)/zeta(2n)^2 (with a(0)=2 instead of -2).
Least k such that Phi(k,n), the k-th cyclotomic polynomial evaluated at n, is prime.

description: Half-Fibonacci: add previous two terms, halving each if even
oeis_name: Having specified two initial terms, the "Half-Fibonacci" sequence proceeds like the Fibonacci sequence, except that the terms are halved before being added if they are even.

description: Abelian cubes of length \(3n\) over a three-letter alphabet
oeis_name: Number of Abelian cubes of length 3n over an alphabet of size 3. An Abelian cube is a string of the form x x' x'' with |x| = |x'| = |x''| and x is a permutation of x' and x''.
Generalized Bessel numbers.
Number of ways to write the n-th positive odd integer in the form p+2^x+7*2^y with p a prime congruent to 5 mod 6 and x,y positive integers.
a(n) = denominator of Sum_{i=1..n} (1/i)*C(2n-i-1,i-1).
a(n) = Sum_{k=0..n} (-4)^k*binomial(n,k)^2*binomial(n-k,k)^2.
a(n) = Sum_{k=0..n} binomial(n,k)^2*binomial(n-k,k)^2*(-16)^k.
a(n) = Sum_{k=0..floor(n/2)} C(n-k,k)^4.

description: Positive integers \(\le n\) strongly prime to \(n\)
oeis_name: The number of positive integers <= n that are strongly prime to n.

description: Square of the n-th primorial, plus one
oeis_name: a(n) = prime(n)#^2 + 1, where prime(n)# is the n-th primorial (A002110).

description: Number of prime representations satisfying parity-dependent Jacobi-symbol conditions
oeis_name: Number of ways to write n = p+q+(n mod 2)q, where p is an odd prime and q<=n/2 is a prime such that JacobiSymbol[q,n]=1 if n is odd, and JacobiSymbol[(q+1)/2,n+1]=1 if n is even.

description: Distinct nonempty subset sums of the proper divisors of \(n\)
oeis_name: Number of distinct sums of distinct proper divisors of n.
Size of the smallest subset S of T = {1,2,3,...,n} such that S*S contains T, where S*S is the set of all products of elements of S.

description: Ranks of harmonic partial sums jointly ordered with \(\log(k+1)\)
oeis_name: Position of n-th partial sum of the harmonic series when all the partial sums are jointly ranked with the set {log(k+1)}; complement of A206912.

description: Numbers \(n+\lfloor5\varphi n\rfloor+\lfloor\varphi^2n\rfloor\), where \(\varphi\) is the golden ratio
oeis_name: n + [nr/t] + [ns/t], where []=floor, r=5, s=(1+sqrt(5))/2, t=1/s.
Integral factorial ratio sequence: a(n) = (30*n)!*n!/((15*n)!*(10*n)!*(6*n)!).
Number of ways to write n = p+q(3-(-1)^n)/2 with p>q and p, q, p-6, q+6 all prime.
a(n) = least k such that sqrt(k^2 XOR (k+1)^2) = 2*n+1, a(n) = -1 if there is no such k.
Number of ways to write n = x + y (x, y > 0) such that 6*x-1 is a Sophie Germain prime and {6*y-1, 6*y+1} is a twin prime pair.

description: Hankel determinants of the Apéry numbers A005259
oeis_name: Determinant of the (n+1) X (n+1) Hankel-type matrix with (i,j)-entry equal to A005259(i+j) for all i,j = 0,...,n.

description: Determinants of matrices indicating primality of both \(n\pm(i-j)\).
oeis_name: Determinant of the n X n matrix with (i,j)-entry (i,j = 0,...,n-1) equal to 1 or 0 according as n + i - j and n - i + j are both prime or not.

description: Partitions \(n=x+y+z\), \(x\le y\le z\), with all \(2x_i-1,2x_ix_j-1\) prime
oeis_name: Number of ways to write n = x + y + z with 0 < x <= y <= z such that all the six numbers 2*x-1, 2*y-1, 2*z-1, 2*x*y-1, 2*x*z-1, 2*y*z-1 are prime.
Number of ways to write n = p + q (q > 0) with p and (phi(p)*phi(q))^4 + 1 prime, where phi(.) is Euler's totient function (A000010).

description: Count of \(0<k<n\) such that \((k+1)^{\phi(n-k)}+k\) is prime
oeis_name: a(n) = |{0 < k < n: (k+1)^{phi(n-k)} + k is prime}|, where phi(.) is Euler's totient function.
Number of ordered ways to write 2*n = p + q with p, q and prime(p + 2) + 2 all prime.

description: Number of parts in the symmetric representation of \(\sigma(n)\)
oeis_name: Number of parts in the symmetric representation of sigma(n).

description: Number of adjacent length-n intervals containing equal prime counts
oeis_name: a(n) = |{0 < k < n: the two intervals (k*n, (k+1)*n) and ((k+1)*n, (k+2)*n) contain the same number of primes}|.

description: Maximum least base among representations by at most four squares
oeis_name: a(n) is the largest integer such that n = a(n)^2 + ... is a decomposition of n into a sum of at most four nondecreasing squares.

description: Partial sums of \(10^k\), negating terms with prime \(k\)
oeis_name: a(n) = Sum_{k=1..n} (-1)^isprime(k)*10^k.
Smallest prime factor of 2^(2^n+2) + 3.

description: Floor of \(n^2/\sum_i d_i d_{i+1}\) for ordered divisors
oeis_name: Let n>=2 be a positive integer with divisors 1 = d_1 < d_2 < ... < d_k = n, and s = d_1*d_2 + d_2*d_3 + ... + d_(k-1)*d_k. The sequence lists the values a(n) = floor(n^2/s).

description: Number of partitions of n into distinct nonsquarefree parts
oeis_name: Number of partitions of n into distinct parts that are not squarefree.

description: Ménage seatings when M sits nine seats clockwise from wife
oeis_name: A total of n married couples, including a mathematician M and his wife, are to be seated at the 2n chairs around a circular table, with no man seated next to his wife. After the ladies are seated at every other chair, M is the first man allowed to choose one of the remaining chairs. The sequence gives the number of ways of seating the other men, with no man seated next to his wife, if M chooses the chair that is 9 seats clockwise from his wife's chair.
Number of primes p such that n-(p*n'-1) and n+(p*n'-1) are both prime, where n' is 1 or 2 according as n is odd or even.

description: Ordered four-square representations with z>0 and yz(5x^2+7y^2+9z^2) square
oeis_name: Number of ordered ways to write n as x^2 + y^2 + z^2 + w^2 with (5*x^2+7*y^2+9*z^2)*y*z a square, where x,y,z,w are nonnegative integers with z > 0.
Number of ways to write pi(T(n)) = pi(T(k)) + pi(T(m)) with 1 < k < m < n, where T(x) is the triangular number x*(x+1)/2, and pi(x) is the number of primes not exceeding x.

description: Number of ordered positive pairs satisfying \(n=\pi(k(k+1))+\pi(m(m+1)/2)\)
oeis_name: Number of ordered pairs (k, m) with k > 0 and m > 0 such that n = pi(k*(k+1)) + pi(m*(m+1)/2), where pi(x) denotes the number of primes not exceeding x.
Denominator of the rational number Sum_{d|n}1/(d+1).

description: Decimal values of prefixes of Rule 167’s middle column
oeis_name: Decimal representation of the middle column of the "Rule 167" elementary cellular automaton starting with a single ON (black) cell.

description: Ordered nonnegative representations n=w^2+x^2+y^2+z^2 with 3x^2+4y^2+9z^2 square
oeis_name: Number of ordered ways to write n as w^2 + x^2 + y^2 + z^2  with 3*x^2 + 4*y^2 + 9*z^2 a square, where w, x, y and z are nonnegative integers.

description: Second most significant bit of the \(n\)-th Tribonacci number
oeis_name: Second most significant bit of the tribonacci number A000073(n).

description: Smallest Harshad amicable partner distinct from \(n\)
oeis_name: a(n) is the smallest k different from n such that (n, k) is a Harshad amicable pair (see the comments).

description: Number of nonnegative integer solutions to \(n=x^2+2y^2+3z^3+4w^4\)
oeis_name: Number of ways to write n as x^2 + 2*y^2 + 3*z^3 + 4*w^4 with x,y,z,w nonnegative integers.
a(n) = hypergeometric([n, -n], [], -1).

description: Odd divisors of n minus middle divisors of n
oeis_name: Number of odd divisors of n minus the number of middle divisors of n.
Main diagonal of A276554.

description: Numerators of partial sums in Gosper’s series for \(\zeta(3)\)
oeis_name: Numerator of Sum_{k=1..n} (30k-11)/(4*(2k-1)*k^3*binomial(2k,k)^2).

description: Least period of the sequence \(k^3 \bmod n\).
oeis_name: Period of cubes mod n.

description: Positions of 0’s in the fixed point of 0→01, 1→0100
oeis_name: Positions of 0 in A284851; complement of A284853.

description: Cumulative signs of decimal digit-sum differences \(d(5k)-d(k)\)
Sum of deficiencies over all divisors of \(n\)
oeis_name: Sum of deficiencies of divisors of n.

description: Steps for halving-mass cellular automaton to reach unit masses
oeis_name: a(n) is the number of steps needed to reach a stable configuration in the 1D cellular automaton initialized with one cell with mass n and based on the rule "each cell gives half of its mass, rounded down, to its right neighbor".
Number of ways to write n as a^2 + b^2 + binomial(2*c+1,c) + binomial(2*d+1,d), where a,b,c,d are nonnegative integers with a <= b and c <= d.

description: \(k\) whose base-\(b\) expansions use ≤2 distinct digits (\(3\le b<k\))
oeis_name: Numbers k such that the base-b expansion of k for each b = 3..k-1 never contains more than two distinct digits.
a(n) is the number of natural bases b < 2n+1 such that b^n == -1 (mod 2n+1).
a(n) is the denominator of F(n) = A027641(n-1)/n + A027642(n-1)/n^2.

description: Numerators of the Dirichlet convolution square root of A046644
oeis_name: Numerators of sequence whose Dirichlet convolution with itself yields A046644.

description: Collatz-tree node values indexed by their nonnegative-integer encodings
oeis_name: a(n) is the value of the node of the Collatz tree encoded by the number n (see Comments for precise definition).

description: Digit sum of \(n\) modulo digit sum of \(n+1\)
oeis_name: a(n) = (sum of digits of n) mod (sum of digits of n+1).

description: Weighted sums of Apéry numbers and central coefficients of $(x^2+4x-1)^k$
oeis_name: a(n) = (Sum_{k=0..n-1}(-1)^k*(15*k+8)*beta(k)*t(k))/(2*n), where beta(k) = A005258(k), and t(k) is the coefficient of x^k in the expansion of (x^2+4*x-1)^k.
a(n) is the least decimal digit of n^3.

description: Ratios of consecutive terms of A334958
oeis_name: Ratios of consecutive terms of A334958.

description: Normalized weighted sums of generalized trinomial-coefficient products
oeis_name: a(n) = (Sum_{k=0..n-1}(540*k + 137)*3136^(n-1-k)*C(2*k, k)*T_k(2, 81)*T_k(14, 81))/ (2*n*C(2*n, n)), where T_k(b, c) denotes the coefficient of x^k in the expansion of (x^2 + b*x + c)^k.
a(n) = Product_{k in GB(2*n)} k, where GB(n) is the set of primes which are Goldbach-associated with n.

description: Concatenated prime factors of n (with multiplicity), modulo n
oeis_name: a(n) is the concatenation of the prime factors (with multiplicity) of n mod n.
Numerators of a sequence of fractions converging to e.

description: Denominators of conjecturally convergent rational approximations to \(e\)
oeis_name: Denominator of a sequence of fractions converging to e.
Row sums of A340880.
a(n) = floor(r*floor(r*n)), where r = (2 + sqrt(5))/2.

description: A003958 applied to the divisor sum: \(A003958(\sigma(n))\)
oeis_name: a(n) = A003958(sigma(n)), where A003958 is multiplicative with a(p^e) = (p-1)^e and sigma is the sum of divisors function.
Start with 2*n-1; repeatedly triple and add 2 until reaching a prime. a(n) = number of steps until reaching a prime > 2*n-1, or 0 if no prime is ever reached.
a(n) = binomial(3*n,n)^2 - 27*binomial(2*n,n).
a(n) = Sum_{k = 0..n-1} binomial(n,k)^2 * binomial(n+k-1,k)^2.
Denominator of the continued fraction 1/(2-3/(3-4/(4-5/(...(n-1)-n/(-2))))).
Denominator of the continued fraction 1/(2-3/(3-4/(4-5/(...(n-1)-n/(-4))))).
a(1) = 2; for n >= 2, a(n) = p^6 if p == 2 (mod 3), p^7 if p = 3 or p == 1 (mod 3), where p = prime(n).
Denominator of the continued fraction 1/(2-3/(3-4/(4-5/(...(n-1)-n/(n+4))))).

description: Minimum under optional zero-digit deletion after each factorial multiplication
oeis_name: Minimized zeroless factorials.
Lexicographically earliest infinite sequence such that a(i) = a(j) => f(i) = f(j), for all i, j, where f(n) = [A003415(n), A085731(n)] if A359550(n) = 1, otherwise f(n) = n.

description: Numbers whose prime divisors share the same final digit.
oeis_name: Numbers whose prime divisors all end in the same digit.

description: Row sums of irregular triangle A381587
oeis_name: Row sums of irregular triangle A381587.

description: First component of a coupled bilinear sum-difference recurrence
oeis_name: a(n) = a(n-1)*b(n-2) + a(n-2)*b(n-1) and b(n) = a(n-1)*b(n-2) - a(n-2)*b(n-1) starting with a(0) = b(0) = b(1) = 1 and a(1) = 2.

description: Number of occurrences of \(n\) in A049802.
oeis_name: a(n) is the number of occurrences of n in A049802.

description: Maximum plane regions formed by \(n\) concentric congruent regular pentagrams
oeis_name: a(0) = 1; thereafter a(n) = 10*n^2 - 5*n + 2.

description: Least k having exactly n divisors d with d^d ≡ d (mod k).
oeis_name: a(n) is the smallest integer k such that A384237(k) = n.
a(n) = Sum_{k=1..n} binomial(n, k) (mod 2^k).
